units.source_text: 源氏想起岁律将暮，不胜寂寥。

en.t: Genji thought of how the year was drawing to its close, and he could not bear the loneliness.

units.source_text: 忽见三皇子东奔西走，喊着：“我要赶鬼，什么东西声音最响？”

en.t: Suddenly he saw the Third Prince running this way and that, shouting, "I want to drive away the demons. What makes the loudest sound?"
The sight of him was very endearing.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“我出家之后，不能再见这种景象了！”

en.t: Genji thought, "After I become a monk, I will no longer be able to see scenes like this."

units.source_text: 无论何事，触景生悲，难于禁受。

en.t: Whatever he looked at stirred his sorrow, and it was hard for him to endure.
So he composed a poem, saying:
